title: DocumentCreateRequest
description: Request body for creating a new document. A document can be created from a PandaDoc template, a remote URL, or a content library item.

name.description: Display name for the new document.

template_uuid.description: Identifier of the PandaDoc template to generate the document from. Required when not providing a URL or file.

url.description: Publicly accessible URL of a PDF or DOCX file to use as the document source. Used when not creating from a template.

recipients.description: List of recipients to assign to the document.

fields.description: Map of field name to field value for populating document fields. Field names correspond to placeholders defined in the template.

value.description: The value to assign to the field.

role.description: Role name that owns this field.

tokens.description: List of token name-value pairs for substituting content placeholders in the document.

name.description: Token placeholder name as defined in the template.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata to attach to the document for reference by the integrating application.

tags.description: List of tags to apply to the document.

folder_uuid.description: Identifier of the folder in which to store the document.
